against.head: Resistance +0.2% above
against.text: The nearest ceiling is +0.2% above (right at the close), where 5 levels (5 kinds) meet: the 200-week average, the most-traded price of six months and the average price paid since the Jul 29 high: little room before sellers have stepped in before.
against.learn: A ceiling: sellers stepped in there before.

material.head: Wave 2 turning up from its zone
material.text: Five clean waves up from Apr 9 to Jul 29 (+47%, wave 1). The pullback turned up from the 0.618–0.786 zone of that advance (−6% to −12%), in three waves, on lighter volume, with the Oct 14 low in the same place. The count is wrong under the start of wave 1 (−20%); a close over the wave-1 high (+17%) says wave 3 is under way.
material.learn: After five waves up the pullback usually ends between the 0.618 and 0.786 retracement of the advance; a close turning up there is the buy.

material.head: A bull flag
material.text: It ran +16% in 15 sessions, then drifted for 5 sessions on lighter volume, giving back 48% of the run: a pause that often precedes the next leg.
material.learn: A sharp move (the pole), then a shallow drift on light volume (the flag); the next leg often matches much of the pole.

material.head: Support −0.9% below
material.text: The nearest floor is −0.9% below (0.4 ATR), where 11 levels (4 kinds) meet: the February breakout level, the 200-day average and the average price paid since the Oct 14 low.
material.learn: A price where buyers stepped in before.

material.head: Back above its averages
material.text: Price has climbed back above both its 50-day and 200-day averages.
material.learn: The average close of the last 20, 50 or 200 sessions; rising averages mark uptrends and often act as support.

material.head: Holding its rising 20-day
material.text: It dipped to its rising 20-day average in the last three sessions and held above it.
